mapper.update: MERGE INTO MEMBER_MEMO t USING ( SELECT #{memberId} AS MEMBER_ID, #{memo} AS MEMO FROM dual ) s ON (t.MEMBER_ID = s.MEMBER_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.MEMO = s.MEMO, t.UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (MEMBER_ID, MEMO, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (s.MEMBER_ID, s.MEMO, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP)
